verdict.rationale: Typesense is API-first: the docs say the complete API surface ships in the open-source server [typesense-docs-61], Cloud advertises "Full API Access" alongside its Visual Dashboard [typesense-docs-56], and a community user describes it as Lucene-like features plus a REST interface [typesense-comm-3]. The Cloud MCP server lets an agent create and configure clusters, build collections, index data, tune search and read metrics [typesense-docs-43], which reaches dashboard-level operations. However, no explicit dashboard-to-API parity statement exists, and the OpenAPI spec probes returned 404 [typesense-probe-3]. Missing for 10: an explicit documented guarantee that every Cloud dashboard action (team access, RBAC, SSO, billing) has an API equivalent, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
